title: The Drowned Bell
description: A cathedral went under off the coast a long time ago, and the parish
has kept singing anyway, which is the whole trouble. The bell still
hangs in its tower under the water, and the sexton's ledger says it
has one toll left in it, owed to whoever raises it.
Mechanically this group is the sea's own vocabulary: tasks that count
kills, fluids handed over by the bucket, an item that has to be the
item -- renamed, not just shaped like it -- and a reward that pays
the whole table at once when the bell finally speaks.
`structure`, a slow `observation`, `all_table` and an inline table,
and a description withheld until its quest is done.
